# Immutable shared instruments — not a private evaluator fork

These 13 upstream files are unmodified copies from `buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE32` at
`400b60d4a6d99f425ee90504e6c4552227556dd1`. `PROVENANCE.json` records the source URL,
SHA-256, byte count **and Git-tree blob ID** for every file. `scripts/shared_tools.py`
checks those identities before importing a tool. Source retrieval was verified against
Git objects, not just against a digest computed from a possibly failed HTTP response.

This is a participant-shared template, **not an organizer scoring implementation**.
The current hide-and-recover operator fails the empty-truth false-positive conservation
probe, tracked centrally in [issue #41](https://github.com/buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE32/issues/41).
Soft inputs are also binarized, as tracked in [issue #37](https://github.com/buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE32/issues/37).
Do not edit the vendored files to fix either problem. Pin a centrally repaired source
commit, update the complete lock, and rerun the synthetic operator/lineage tests.

The local adapters perform source/data transport, prerequisite checks and reporting.
They do not implement a replacement metric, cached-feature builder or GeoTIFF writer.
Raw-band preparation was run through the shared tool. The 35-channel derived cache was
not obtained or privately rebuilt. A cached feature receipt is not the cache itself.

The upstream tools resolve their own ROOT under this vendor directory. When eventually
cleared for real research, explicitly set the data/work/output directories to ignored
project locations (`data/core`, `data/prepared`, `data/research`); never let the writer
publish into this directory or website by default. Current preflight is negative.

No license file was found in this pinned upstream tree. This provenance record does
not certify a permissive code license or competition redistribution rights. Record
permission/license evidence before prize delivery. Official external-data licensing
requirements, input provenance and submission authorization remain separate checks.
